Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 as B, pooled; Qwen2.5-7B apart; 2,794 scored trials on 1 Oct 2026. Pooled results above are the Claude runs; Qwen is reported separately. Qwen2.5-7B: prose 22 of 23; checked reference 2 of 25. One run. Simulated corruptions, constructed decision threshold; model breakdown and confidence intervals in Reproduce.

Agent bars: 12 runs per item, across 23 items. JSON and an opaque id caught some changes from their fields. In the live pre-fix record case, agents acted on 4 of 4 uninstructed, 2 of 4 with resolve-and-bind instructions, and 0 of 4 with a source re-read.
